title: [マジカミ DX] Magicami DX H-Scene Archive Update 2 [EN, JP] [Update 12-6-2021]
description:
### For the second part of the archive refer to https://sukebei.nyaa.si/view/3309116 ###
### For the fourth part go to https://sukebei.nyaa.si/view/3437638 ###


Here is the next update to the Magicami DX H-scene archive. **This release includes the Kisaku 2021 Paid Collab scenes and Taimanin Paid Collab scenes.**

**Missing scenes: Seishuu Chikan Densha Paid Collab scenes (5-9).**


The "Seira - Anubis" scene was censored in the global release. So we remade it from scratch using the uncensored assets and a custom-made external viewer. 
Don't expect the other dresses to recieve this treatment. We currently have no proper built-in viewer like TABA does so the process of making scenes is hard and time-consuming.


We've also started to record sex loops at the end of each scene as requested. This change will not be retroactive for the time being. 


Lastly a few notes about the paid scenes. 
Their quality is what it is. They were provided by third parties outside of our group. So please don't ask for rerecordings of those. If you want them in better quality or early you can always pay up. 
Also I'll try getting the ones from future collabs too but given that these scenes depend on someone actually spending money I can't guarantee I'll be able to. Feel free to share them if you get any.


if you find any other mistakes feel free to point them out. I'll try to fix them.

**As always please remember to seed. And play the game if you liked it. Have fun!**
